sourceMethod: Built-in image generation; geometry/alpha/format export script included

limits.reducedMotion: render one stable frame; no ambient oscillation or drift

notes: Masters keep requested exactdimensions. Central5/6 width is the viewport; remaining1/6 gives20% horizontal overscan relative to the viewport.
Separate source drawings were generated then geometrically placed; phone components retain object aspect rather than stretching the wholelandscape.
Sky and water tile edges are matched with32px edgeconditioning; native ripple shapes arepreserved. Clouds use clear alpha at both edges.
Mode differences are coordinated lighting/placement routes over shared continuous environment layers, not five new flattenedpaintings.
Static composites are fallbacks and inspectionreferences, not the animation implementation.
Large transparent master canvases should not be uploaded as atlases; use providedruntime copies and trim-to-alpha subtextures ifdesired.
